description: This source file defines the class AdoNetGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder, which implements IProviderBuilder<ISiloBuilder> to configure an AdoNet-based grain directory provider within Orleans Silo builds. It involves setting connection options and configuring services based on provided configuration sections.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder
classes.description: A sealed internal class that implements IProviderBuilder to configure ADO.NET based grain directory providers for Orleans Silo.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the AdoNet grain directory provider with connection options based on the provided configuration section and adds it to the silo builder.
